notes: Ask about service hours or a stipend; the page does not say.
name: Arlington Teen Network Board (TNB)
what_you_do: A teen group named by the County Board and School Board. Members talk about youth issues and make advice for leaders. They work in one of four teams: drug and alcohol prevention, healthy relationships, peer to peer, or volunteering and internships.
duration: Meets the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of each month in the school year, 6:30 to 8:00 p.m.
how_to_apply: The page has no application steps. Email Linh Nghe, Prevention Director, at lnghe@arlingtonva.us to ask about joining.
